messages:
Nina K: Quick check - webinar tomorrow. Need final run-of-show, who has the slide-lock?

Tom R: I locked slides at noon. Deck link: https://drive.redwood/slides/apr-webinar-final. Please don't edit after 6pm PT.

Ibrahim A: Demo readiness: I created a snapshot of the demo VM and uploaded the recorded fallback (start 00:01:45). URL: https://video.redwood/fallbacks/demo-clip.mp4

Sofia L: Lead routing ask: if we get >=4 signups in rolling 15m, post to #sales-hot-leads and ping @oncall-sales. Otherwise batch to SDR inbox every 20m.

Nina K: Can we have a simple command to flip to recorded clip? Add to runbook please.

Ibrahim A: Adding API snippet: 
```bash
# flip demo to recorded fallback
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/stream/swap \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STREAM_KEY" \
  -d '{"mode":"recorded","url":"https://video.redwood/fallbacks/demo-clip.mp4"}'
```

Tom R: Rehearsal notes: presenters join 20m early for AV; host will trigger countdown for slide changes; moderator (Sofia) controls audience q's.

Sofia L: I'll moderate and own timing. Also added canned lines for hallucination: "We're moving to a safe demo while we investigate that answer." Keep it concise.

AlertBot: [automated] health-check: GPU 52%, CPU 60%, avg latency 210ms. No alerts.

Nina K: Perfect. Final: preflight 09:50 PT in #marketing. Everyone confirm availability.

Tom R: Confirmed.

Ibrahim A: Confirmed.

Sofia L: Confirmed.
